hook.text: A blend of emo, screamo and post-rock from a Japanese band, and the one album they recorded with three guitarists.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: Winter 2003 at Bazooka Japan Institute, Tokyo, Japan

facts.label: Label
facts.value: Level Plane, Rock Action, Temporary Residence

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Dairoku Seki (drums), Tetsuya Fukagawa (sequencer, vocals), Nobukata Kawai (guitar), Masahiro Tobita (guitar), Manabu Nakagawa (bass guitar), Daichi Takasugi (guitar)

sentences.text: Guitarist Daichi Takasugi joined Envy before the album was created, and he left after the tour linked to it.
Besides the six players, the credits name two more people: Takashi Kitaguchi for engineering and Tatsuya Kase for mastering the album.
